description: upGrad signed an MoU with the Government of Maharashtra to create AI talent and drive employment. The initiative aims to set up AI Excellence Centers and urban universities, benefiting over 1 million students and 250,000 rural youth. The project positions Maharashtra as a global education hub, bridging talent gaps and fostering innovation.
body_lead: upGrad, one of Asia's largest integrated skilling and forever learning majors, has signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Maharashtra in the presence of Hon. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and Ronnie Screwvala at Davos, yesterday. The initiative aims to create a world-class AI talent base for global jobs and drive employment opportunities across the State.upGrad Institute of AI Excellence Centers across Maharashtra to equip over 1 Mn students in AI and emerging technologies.
